mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, parent_id, level, sort_order, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{level}, #{sortOrder}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, parent_id AS parentId, level, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM category WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY level ASC, sort_order ASC
SELECT id, name, parent_id AS parentId, level, sort_order AS sortOrder, is_active AS isActive FROM category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE category SET is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
